paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the Owner's requirement for major equipment installation and integration as outlined in PM-02. The proposer will install and integrate Owner-furnished equipment into the overall data center design, ensuring compatibility and functionality within the system's architecture.

Regarding pricing and cost breakdown, the proposer confirms that prices will be firm, all-inclusive, quoted in US dollars, and free of taxes. The price schedule will separate equipment, freight, installation, commissioning, spares, and five years of maintenance, with any extensions priced as an option.
The proposer accepts the Owner's requirement for unconditional pricing, ensuring no 'to be discussed' items or references to separate contracts are included in the offer.
The proposer confirms that the offer will remain valid for at least four months after the submission deadline, as required by the Owner.
